description: Fix all server-side bugs that break the mentorship flow end-to-end. Covers: (1) missing authenticate middleware on mentorshipRoutes.js and mentorRoutes.js; (2) Notification.create missing required title field in mentorshipController; (3) Mentorship.create missing required request field; (4) populate('name') on User which has firstName/lastName; (5) mentorController filter fields wrong (Profile has domains[], not domain; department/batch on User not Profile); (6) dashboardController response shape mismatch with frontend DashboardStats interface; (7) Create server/.env with secure JWT_SECRET. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Create server/.env at e:\da\Alumini proj\server\.env with NODE_ENV=development, PORT=3000, MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/alumni_network, JWT_SECRET=<generate 64-char hex>, JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d, CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:4200. Create server/.gitignore if missing, add .env to it. Create server/.env.example with same keys but placeholder values.

Fix server/src/routes/mentorshipRoutes.js: import authenticate from '../middleware/auth'; add authenticate as first middleware on ALL 8 routes (POST /request, GET /requests, PATCH /request/:id/status, GET /my, GET /:id, PATCH /:id/goals, PATCH /:id/milestones, GET /:id/milestones).
Fix server/src/routes/mentorRoutes.js: import authenticate from '../middleware/auth'; add authenticate middleware to GET / route.

Fix server/src/controllers/mentorshipController.js — three Notification.create calls: (a) in requestMentor add title: 'New Mentorship Request' and remove relatedModel field; (b) in updateRequestStatus acceptance branch add title: 'Mentorship Request Accepted' and remove relatedModel; (c) in updateRequestStatus declined branch add title: 'Mentorship Request Declined' and remove relatedModel. Notification schema requires title.
Fix server/src/controllers/mentorshipController.js — Mentorship.create in updateRequestStatus: add request: request._id field (Mentorship schema requires it). Also add startDate: new Date().

Fix server/src/controllers/mentorshipController.js — all populate calls: change .populate('student', 'name email avatar') to .populate('student', 'firstName lastName email') and .populate('mentor', 'name email avatar') to .populate('mentor', 'firstName lastName email'). Update ALL mapping code to use `${r.mentor.firstName} ${r.mentor.lastName}` for mentorName and `${r.student.firstName} ${r.student.lastName}` for studentName. Applies to getRequests, getMyMentorships, getMentorshipDetails, getMilestones functions.

Fix server/src/controllers/mentorController.js: (a) Replace User.find query to include department/batch filters: const userFilter = { role: 'alumni' }; if (department) userFilter.department = department; if (batch) userFilter.batch = batch; const alumniUsers = await User.find(userFilter).select('_id firstName lastName email department batch'); (b) Fix profileQuery: change profileQuery.domain to profileQuery.domains = domain (Profile field is 'domains' array); change profileQuery['experience.company'] to profileQuery.currentCompany = new RegExp(company, 'i'); remove profileQuery.department and profileQuery.batch (now on User query). (c) Change populate to: .populate('user', 'firstName lastName email department batch'). (d) In response mapping add userId: mentor.user._id.toString(), name: mentor.user.firstName + ' ' + mentor.user.lastName, department: mentor.user.department, batch: mentor.user.batch, company: mentor.currentCompany || '', jobTitle: mentor.currentRole || '', bio: mentor.bio || ''.

Fix server/src/controllers/dashboardController.js: Add shared queries for all roles at top of getStats handler: const [totalAlumni, upcomingEventsCount, openOpportunitiesCount] = await Promise.all([User.countDocuments({ role: 'alumni' }), Event.countDocuments({ date: { $gte: new Date() } }), Opportunity.countDocuments({ status: 'active' })]); For activeMentorships: student role uses { student: userId, status: 'active' }, alumni uses { mentor: userId, status: 'active' }, admin uses { status: 'active' }. Include totalAlumni, upcomingEvents, openOpportunities in all three role responses alongside the existing role-specific stats. Update chartData for each role to use real DB aggregation, removing any hardcoded arrays.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/mentorship/request with valid student JWT and valid mentorId+message returns 201 with the created request (no ValidationError from Notification.create)
PATCH /api/mentorship/request/:id/status with mentor JWT and {status:'accepted'} returns 200 with request and mentorship objects — no ValidationError about missing 'request' or 'title' fields
GET /api/mentorship/requests returns requests with non-null studentName and mentorName strings (not undefined)
GET /api/mentors with valid JWT returns array where each item has name (full string), userId, department, batch, company fields
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns object with totalAlumni, activeMentorships, upcomingEvents, openOpportunities fields for student, alumni, and admin roles
server/.env file exists and JWT_SECRET is not 'fallback_secret_do_not_use_in_prod'
verification: cd 'e:\da\Alumini proj\server' && npm run dev -- verify server starts without crash on port 3000
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/mentorship/requests | python -m json.tool -- verify 401 response (no token)
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/mentors | python -m json.tool -- verify 401 response (no token)
Manual API test: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials, use returned token to POST /api/mentorship/request -- verify 201 and no ValidationError in server logs
cd 'e:\da\Alumini proj\client' && npm run build -- 0 compile errors (no TypeScript changes in this FEAT)
findings: 1. Notification schema has no relatedModel field — removed it from all three Notification.create calls. 2. Mentorship schema requires 'request' field (ObjectId ref to MentorshipRequest) — added request: request._id and startDate: new Date() in updateRequestStatus. 3. User schema uses firstName/lastName, not name — fixed all populate calls and name mappings in mentorshipController and mentorController. 4. Profile schema: domains[] (array), currentCompany, currentRole — fixed mentorController filters (domain->domains, experience.company->currentCompany). department/batch moved to User-level query. 5. dashboardController now returns normalized shape with totalAlumni, activeMentorships, upcomingEvents, openOpportunities for all roles (student/alumni/admin). 6. server/.env created with generated 64-char hex JWT_SECRET. server/.gitignore and server/.env.example also created. 7. Angular client builds with 0 errors after server-only changes.
